extends Control
class_name PauseController

signal pause_changed(paused: bool, reason: String)
signal save_requested
signal unstuck_requested

var _paused := false
var _pause_reason := "none"
var _panel: Panel
var _status: Label
var _volume_slider: HSlider
var _camera_slider: HSlider
var _quality_option: OptionButton
var _syncing_settings := false

func _ready() -> void:
    process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
    mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
    set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    visible = false
    _build_ui()
    refresh_settings_ui()

func is_game_paused() -> bool:
    return _paused

func pause_game(reason: String = "user") -> void:
    if _paused:
        return
    _paused = true
    _pause_reason = reason
    visible = true
    get_tree().paused = true
    pause_changed.emit(true, reason)

func resume_game(reason: String = "user") -> void:
    if not _paused:
        return
    get_tree().paused = false
    _paused = false
    _pause_reason = "none"
    visible = false
    pause_changed.emit(false, reason)

func toggle_pause() -> void:
    if _paused:
        resume_game("toggle")
    else:
        pause_game("toggle")

func set_status(text: String) -> void:
    if _status:
        _status.text = text

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
    if event.is_action_pressed("ui_cancel"):
        toggle_pause()
        get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _build_ui() -> void:
    var shade := ColorRect.new()
    shade.name = "Shade"
    shade.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    shade.color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.66)
    shade.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
    add_child(shade)

    _panel = Panel.new()
    _panel.name = "Panel"
    _panel.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
    _panel.position = Vector2(-210, -285)
    _panel.size = Vector2(420, 570)
    add_child(_panel)

    var margin := MarginContainer.new()
    margin.name = "Margin"
    margin.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 26)
    margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 24)
    margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 26)
    margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 24)
    _panel.add_child(margin)

    var box := VBoxContainer.new()
    box.name = "VBox"
    box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
    margin.add_child(box)

    var title := Label.new()
    title.text = "حياة تونس — توقف"
    title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
    box.add_child(title)

    _status = Label.new()
    _status.name = "Status"
    _status.text = "اللعبة متوقفة"
    _status.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    box.add_child(_status)

    var resume_button := Button.new()
    resume_button.name = "ResumeButton"
    resume_button.text = "واصل اللعب"
    resume_button.pressed.connect(func(): resume_game("menu"))
    box.add_child(resume_button)

    var save_button := Button.new()
    save_button.name = "SaveButton"
    save_button.text = "احفظ الآن"
    save_button.pressed.connect(func(): save_requested.emit())
    box.add_child(save_button)

    var settings_title := Label.new()
    settings_title.name = "SettingsTitle"
    settings_title.text = "الإعدادات"
    settings_title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    settings_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
    box.add_child(settings_title)

    var volume_label := Label.new()
    volume_label.text = "الصوت الرئيسي"
    box.add_child(volume_label)
    _volume_slider = HSlider.new()
    _volume_slider.name = "MasterVolumeSlider"
    _volume_slider.min_value = 0.0
    _volume_slider.max_value = 1.0
    _volume_slider.step = 0.05
    _volume_slider.value_changed.connect(_on_volume_changed)
    box.add_child(_volume_slider)

    var camera_label := Label.new()
    camera_label.text = "حساسية الكاميرا"
    box.add_child(camera_label)
    _camera_slider = HSlider.new()
    _camera_slider.name = "CameraSensitivitySlider"
    _camera_slider.min_value = 0.001
    _camera_slider.max_value = 0.02
    _camera_slider.step = 0.0005
    _camera_slider.value_changed.connect(_on_camera_sensitivity_changed)
    box.add_child(_camera_slider)

    var quality_label := Label.new()
    quality_label.text = "جودة الرسوم"
    box.add_child(quality_label)
    _quality_option = OptionButton.new()
    _quality_option.name = "QualityModeOption"
    for mode in ["AUTO", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"]:
        _quality_option.add_item(mode)
    _quality_option.item_selected.connect(_on_quality_selected)
    box.add_child(_quality_option)

    var reset_button := Button.new()
    reset_button.name = "ResetSettingsButton"
    reset_button.text = "إعدادات افتراضية"
    reset_button.pressed.connect(_on_reset_settings)
    box.add_child(reset_button)

    var unstuck_button := Button.new()
    unstuck_button.name = "UnstuckButton"
    unstuck_button.text = "ارجع لمكان آمن"
    unstuck_button.pressed.connect(func(): unstuck_requested.emit())
    box.add_child(unstuck_button)


func refresh_settings_ui() -> void:
    if _volume_slider == null or _camera_slider == null or _quality_option == null:
        return
    _syncing_settings = true
    _volume_slider.value = SettingsService.master_volume()
    _camera_slider.value = SettingsService.camera_sensitivity()
    var modes := ["AUTO", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"]
    var index := modes.find(SettingsService.quality_mode())
    _quality_option.select(maxi(index, 0))
    _syncing_settings = false

func _on_volume_changed(value: float) -> void:
    if _syncing_settings:
        return
    SettingsService.set_master_volume(value)

func _on_camera_sensitivity_changed(value: float) -> void:
    if _syncing_settings:
        return
    SettingsService.set_camera_sensitivity(value)

func _on_quality_selected(index: int) -> void:
    if _syncing_settings:
        return
    var modes := ["AUTO", "LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"]
    if index >= 0 and index < modes.size():
        SettingsService.set_quality_mode(modes[index])

func _on_reset_settings() -> void:
    SettingsService.reset_defaults()
    refresh_settings_ui()
    set_status("تمت إعادة الإعدادات الافتراضية")
